name: SM_Post_Support_Oak_PR
dresses: oak roof post 2.65 m on a two-course dressed stone pad, with a cross head and two pegged braces

fit.pivot: base centre; the cross head runs along X

material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: One review round. Post and braces are clean sawn timbers with pegs; brace ends are butted, not housed; the stone pad is four dressed blocks.
